title.zh: 【Copper 支持机构通过 API 和平台界面交易 Hyperliquid 永续合约】
title.en: 【Copper 支持机构通过 API 和平台界面交易 Hyperliquid 永续合约】

current_state.zh: Copper launched an institutional service that lets clients trade Hyperliquid perpetual futures via API and platform UI while assets remain in its non-custodial MPC infrastructure, Copper Vaults, with multi-approval workflows, granular permissions and full audit trails under the same governance framework as ClearLoop.
current_state.en: Copper launched an institutional service that lets clients trade Hyperliquid perpetual futures via API and platform UI while assets remain in its non-custodial MPC infrastructure, Copper Vaults, with multi-approval workflows, granular permissions and full audit trails under the same governance framework as ClearLoop.
